declarations.coverage: Intentionally empty content scope. The factory workflow declaration governs work throughout this factory-profile repository, including tracker work that changes no files. .factory/config.json stays owned by its separate exact declaration.

Intentionally empty local scope: origin names lutzseverino/hemiciclo, the public personal-account repository requested by its maintainer. GitHub configuration adoption is authorized; remote fixes own no local project files. gh API confirms admin access and public visibility; gh variable list shows REPO_CANON_RUNS_ON absent. The owner is a User, so organization-level inheritance does not apply. Preserve the existing repository-owned reviewer configuration.

Inspected all tracked files, README.md, docs/development/README.md, .factory/config.json, and .factory/Dockerfile. Hemiciclo is planning-only with no app code, manifests, workspaces or internal Projects. scripts, operations, vendor and .agents are installed shared tooling or vendored resources; docs organizes documentation. No independently maintained app, service, library or tool needs a component README. Empty scope is intentional.

Drafted from manifests and workspace configuration by `discovery/draft-typescript-astro-stack-scope.mjs`: one `package.json` per Project, included when it matches the stack's manifest facts and excluded naming its differences otherwise. A maintained workspace root package is a Project alongside its members; a shared-only root is not. Uncertain root membership stays unresolved. A root package without workspace members is a Project. The repository holds no matching web Project, so the declaration has no scope.
